item.title: IHOP Closing State College Location
item.description: IHOP is permanently closing its State College restaurant after nearly 12 years in business. The restaurant chain's location at 1661 S. Atherton St. is scheduled to end dining room service at 8 p.m. Monday and will be open for to-go orders only for its final day of business on Tuesday. IHOP's corporate communications department did not respond to a request for comment. item.title: Centre County Coroner Identifies 3 Killed in Christmas Day Crash
item.description: Three members of a Lock Haven family were killed in a Christmas Day crash in Howard Township, the Centre County Coroner's Office reported on Monday. item.title: Detour Planned for Work on I-80/I-99 Interchange in Centre County
item.description: Work on the high-speed interchange project connecting Interstates 80 and 99 near Bellefonte will cause a detour for some travelers beginning in January. The detour will be in place starting Jan. 12 on Route 26 southbound between the I-80 exit 161 westbound off-ramp and Forest Avenue, according to PennDOT. item.title: Regional Halal Restaurant Chain to Open Downtown State College Location
item.description: A growing regional chain of fast casual halal restaurants is coming to downtown State College. Sizzling Bites Halal Grill is planning to open at 129 S. Pugh St., according to signage on the building and information presented earlier this year at a State College Redevelopment Authority meeting. The location has been vacant since Sheetz closed its store there in 2023 after eight years in business. An opening date has not yet been announced. The chain plans to post updates on its Instagram account.
